comment: Sample placements for the measure of free placement (E-005), read by TestPlacementMeasure (Java) and by tests/e2e/free-placement.spec.ts (the page's placement.js). Units: 1024 to a square, x along the files from a, y along the ranks from 1. The radius is the one for 20%. Squares are listed by file and then by rank.
